name: Seduce Me: Simon's Revenge
source:
"I promise to make you the happiest person in the world."

Matthew has always been able to make me smile. However, Simon seems to be driving him a little more crazy than usual...

Why is Simon messing with Matthew?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「我保證讓你成為世界上最幸福的人。」

馬修總能讓我露出笑容。然而，西蒙似乎比平時更加讓他抓狂……

西蒙為什麼要捉弄馬修？
